channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Iran says it hit American vessels, oil tankers in Hormuz in retaliation for U.S. strikes
item.description: The U.S. and Iran traded new attacks around the Strait of Hormuz, as President Donald Trump insists oil prices will drop fast once the Iran war ends.

item.title: G10’s ‘surprise’ currency star could stumble as peers hike interest rates
item.description: The British pound has benefited from a resilient economy and rate hike expectations, but the BOE looks increasingly dovish while a crucial budget lies ahead.

item.title: Trump administration expresses 'profound concern' over Ford's ties to China
item.description: In a letter to Ford CEO Jim Farley, U.S. DOT Secretary Sean Duffy questioned the automaker's strategic trajectory involving Chinese companies.

item.title: The world's highest paid leader is set for a 64% pay rise. Here's how others compare

item.title: How Asia’s ultra-rich are investing and where wealthy Chinese are migrating, according to Maybank Singapore CEO
item.description: Asia's ultra-rich still like gold, but they're branching out to digital assets as well, Maybank Singapore's CEO said.

item.title: Three pieces of advice HSBC has for AI investors

item.title: China's wholesale inflation tops estimates in August on commodity costs, tech demand as consumer price increases meet forecast
item.description: Much of the anticipated pickup reflects a favorable base-effect comparison and higher commodity costs, rather than a genuine strengthening in household demand.

item.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth CA$27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens

item.description: Novartis’ failure raises the stakes for Amgen and Eli Lilly in the race to turn lower Lp(a) levels into fewer heart attacks and strokes.

item.title: China's EV makers shift gears to focus on humanoids as car market slows
